title: Name parse tree
description: JSON Schema for a name-parse-tree — the derivation tree produced when a name parses against the project's name-grammar (Chomsky 1959). The name-grammar admits two productions: a gerund-name (gerund + optional article + noun + zero or more modifiers) and a structure-name (noun + zero or more modifiers). The schema dispatches between the two productions via an if/then/else conditional keyed on the kind discriminator using const to pin each branch; the gerund-name branch requires gerund; the structure-name branch excludes gerund and article via not+required negation.

kind.description: Which production rule the candidate name was parsed against.

gerund.description: The gerund head, present only when kind == gerund-name. Must resolve to a registered transformer record.

article.description: Optional article between gerund and noun, valid only when kind == gerund-name.

noun.description: The noun. Required for both production kinds. Must resolve to a registered structure record.

modifiers.description: Optional sequence of modifier names following the noun. Each modifier must resolve to a structure or concept-modifier record.
